    dividers_c = [c for c in range(w)
                  if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and

        for c in range(w):
            hits = [r for r in other if g[r][c] != target_bg]
            if not hits:
                continue
            reference = g[ref][c]
            value = g[hits[0]][c]
            for r in hits:
                g[r][c] = target_bg
            if reference != ref_bg:
                g[near if reference == value else far][c] = value
        return g

    vertical = [c for c in range(1, w - 1)
                if len({g[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and g[0][c] != bg]
    if vertical:
        d = vertical[0]
        left_bg = Counter(g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(d)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        right_bg = Counter(g[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(d + 1, w)).most_common(1)[0][0]
        left = sum(g[r][c] != left_bg for r in range(h) for c in range(d))
        right = sum(g[r][c] != right_bg for r in range(h) for c in range(d + 1, w))
        ref_left = left >= right

        ref = d - 1 if ref_left else d + 1
        ref_bg = left_bg if ref_left else right_bg
        other = range(d + 1, w) if ref_left else range(d)
        target_bg = right_bg if ref_left else left_bg
        near, far = (d + 1, w - 1) if ref_left else (d - 1, 0)

        for r in range(h):
            hits = [c for c in other if g[r][c] != target_bg]
            if not hits:
                continue
            reference = g[r][ref]
            value = g[r][hits[0]]
            for c in hits:
                g[r][c] = target_bg
            if reference != ref_bg:
                g[r][near if reference == value else far] = value

    return g
